questionDescription: Use peptide directionality vocabulary to name the free alpha-amino end.
prompt: Select the free alpha-amino end of this peptide backbone.

surface.description: A two-residue peptide backbone with free alpha-amino and carboxyl ends.

feedback.correct: Correct. Peptide sequences are conventionally written from the N terminus to the C terminus.
feedback.incorrect: Identify the terminus by the functional group that remains free.
